name: The Rift
review:
The Rift is a 3x5, 17-line arcane slot. Rift Spins ensure wilds, and mystical wilds appear throughout.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with an 815x cap and a 96.3% RTP. A gentle game.

Rift Spins ensure wilds, so the bonus rarely feels empty, and the low volatility makes it a steady pick. The arcane alley setting is moody without being dark.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
